effect: Cast Ice Storm at 4th level. Single use.

name: Scroll of Mind Whip

name: The Right Arm
appearance: Ancient wood of unknown origin, warm to touch. Living moss covers most of the surface. Small flowers bloom and die on their own schedule. Insects appear occasionally that have no business being wherever the bearer currently is.
notes: Tackett refers to it as his right arm. Offered by the Trevash delta spring after Tackett destroyed the ancient spirit corrupting it.
effect:
MELEE: +3 quarterstaff. Automatically deals the most harmful damage type to the target. Once per short rest on a hit: vines root the target until the end of their next turn.

SPELLCASTING FOCUS: Spell save DC +2. Once per long rest: cast any one spell without expending a spell slot.

WILDSHAPE: Staff merges into the druid's non-halfling forms. While merged: +3 to attack and damage rolls, HP maximum increases by druid level, once per wildshape cast one cantrip as a bonus action. In Circle of Stars form the staff remains physical.

weapon_effects.name: Adaptive Damage
weapon_effects.description: Automatically deals whichever damage type is most harmful to the target.

weapon_effects.name: Root
weapon_effects.description: On a hit, vines erupt from the staff and root the target in place until the end of its next turn.

weapon_effects.name: Focused Casting
weapon_effects.description: As a spellcasting focus: cast any one spell without expending a spell slot.

weapon_effects.name: Wildshape Merge
weapon_effects.description: Merges into the druid's non-halfling wildshape forms. While merged: +3 to attack and damage rolls, HP maximum increases by druid level, and once per wildshape you may cast one cantrip as a bonus action. In Circle of Stars form the staff remains physical.

name: Shadowgrain Leather
effect: Always +1 to AC. Additional +1 to AC while in dim light or darkness, for a total of +2.
notes: Commission from Torrin Gallowglass. Dark green-brown leather, forest floor coloring, grain patterns that shift with the light. Melds into wildshape forms per druid rules — AC bonus applies in halfling form only. Torrin's signature: made for someone who knows how to use shadow.

name: Helm of Carix
effect: Immunity to charm and fear. Seize the Opening: once per day, when the wearer does something that genuinely surprises an enemy, gain advantage on their next attack roll.
notes: Commission from Torven forge. Grey-green matching Full Plate +2. Carix's coin standing on edge worked into forehead in subtle relief. The metal was listening when it was made.

name: Helm of the Reaching Hand
effect: Advantage on Insight checks. Reaching Hand: once per day as a reaction when an ally within 30ft makes a death saving throw, grant them advantage on it.
notes: Commission from Torven forge. Amber gold with storm-grey inlay. Veleth's two hands almost touching worked into temple pieces. The metal kept trying to become something it hasn't become yet — the smith let it.

name: Helm of the Open Eye
effect: Darkvision extended by 30ft. Advantage on saving throws against being blinded or deafened.
notes: Commission from Torven forge. Dark metal with green-gold veining matching Kerra's eyes. An open eye worked into the brow — no deity symbol, the metal didn't want one. It wanted a window.

name: Headband of Intellect
effect: Sets INT to 19.

name: Green Fey Armor
effect: Counts as half plate (AC 15 + DEX mod max 2). Appears revealing but magical protection extends invisibly for full coverage. +1 CHA while attuned. Only Enauweyn can attune to this item.
description: Green armor of fey construction. Revealing in appearance but the magical protection extends invisibly — coverage is complete. Luxurious flowing cloth around legs and sleeves gives a mystical quality. The green deepens or lightens subtly with her mood.
notes: Attunement restricted to Enauweyn only.

name: Ring of the Fallen Star
effect: Once per dawn: cast Starfall (see homebrew spells). Spell save DC uses wearer's spell save DC. Additionally, advantage on Perception checks made in darkness or starlight.
notes: Forged from meteorite iron by a civilization that no longer exists. Warm to the touch regardless of temperature. Constellation patterns visible in the metal only in darkness or starlight. Responds to celestial/star magic.

name: Yetgrese Throwing Sword +2
effect: Returns instantly to thrower's hand after a thrown attack, whether it hits or misses.
notes: Saltborn steel — no mechanical effect, flavor only.

name: Hlifar'dhe'gar
notes: Named by Jaygar. Two points of light function as eyes. Previous owner never named it. Ssivanak kept it three years waiting for right owner.
effect: +1 small shield (+1 AC). Command word 'viel'bi-ra' transforms it into a construct guardian (HP 142, AC 17) that stands between you and harm, intercepting damage directed at the attuned wearer. The construct cannot attack. Command word 'chk'TO' returns it to shield form. Also stores one spell up to 4th level.

name: Robe of the Tide
notes: Made from local Yetgrese materials. Iridescent fabric that shifts with movement. Not available in Aethermoor.
effect: Tidal Surge: when the wearer casts a spell dealing cold, lightning, or thunder damage, add 2d6 of the same damage type once per turn. Wearer can breathe underwater and has swimming speed equal to walking speed.

name: Robe of Stilled Thought
notes: Made by Ssivanak herself. Significant item — effectively frees concentration slot while one spell runs autonomously.
effect: One concentration spell cast while wearing this robe does not require concentration — it runs for its full duration or until dismissed. Only one spell benefits at a time. Casting a second concentration spell ends the first immediately.

name: Bracers of Spell Mastery
effect: +2 to spell save DC.
notes: Intended for Elucyne to enhance Fear and other save-based spells.

name: Scroll of Control Water
effect: Cast Control Water (level 4). Single use.
notes: Immediately relevant for ocean travel and combat.

name: Scroll of Lightning Bolt
effect: Cast Lightning Bolt (level 3). Single use.
notes: Included free by Ssivanak to close the deal.

name: Scroll of Greater Invisibility
effect: Cast Greater Invisibility (level 4). Single use.

name: Scroll of Plane Shift
effect: Cast Plane Shift (level 7). Single use.
notes: Given free by Ssivanak in exchange for Jaygar identifying it. Inscription was deliberately damaged by previous owner to obscure contents.

name: Scroll of Sending
effect: Cast Sending once. Deliver a 25 word message to any creature on the same plane. Target can reply.
notes: Received as part of Ssivanak's Stillwater reward.

name: Scroll of Counterspell
effect: Cast Counterspell once. Interrupt a creature casting a spell of 3rd level or lower automatically. Higher levels require ability check.
notes: Received as part of Ssivanak's Stillwater reward.

name: Brooch of Shielding
effect: Resistance to force damage. Immunity to Magic Missile.
notes: Given by Ssivanak as part of Stillwater reward, her choice of item.

notes: Pale green oval stone on silver chain. Carved with unidentified script.

name: Lexica's Enchanted Instrument
description: A lyre-like instrument of unusual construction, typical of no known tradition on Kaemahz. Acquired from a travelling vendor at the Halfweek Festival. One of two such instruments held by the same vendor. Dark wood with unfamiliar inlays, the resonance fuller than the size suggests.
effect: While Bardic Inspiration is active on a creature, the wielder may use their reaction to cast Shield on that creature or on herself.
notes: Enchanted by DUVRAK, Upper Merchant Quarter, Argentveil.

name: Ring of the Knowing
description: Simple band of dark metal of unknown continental origin. Single flat face bearing a symbol worn almost to suggestion by time. Warm to the touch. Eleven years in Ossivane Relk's possession before purchase.
effect: Once per day the wearer may ask one specific, answerable question. The answer arrives in the wearer's own voice as though remembered rather than received. Answers are truthful. The ring occasionally volunteers additional relevant information beyond the question asked — treat this as significant. Questions must be specific: a location, a name, a fact. Abstract questions yield nothing.
notes: Purchased from Ossivane Relk, Linden Street Antiquities Market, Argentveil. Day 89, Year 468. Cost 12,000 gold. Origin unknown — metal not from Kaemahz. Pre-existing symbol unidentified. First use: located factor's man Davan (green coat) to Crestfall House, Seventeen Anchor Row. Ring volunteered 'he is not alone' unprompted. Second use pending.

name: Cold Valley Axe
effect: On attunement: wielder gains the Smite From Afar spell (homebrew, 1st-level Paladin).

name: Breastplate of Planes
effect: On attunement: advantage on concentration saving throws.

name: Shield +2
notes: Standard shield, +2 enhancement.
effect: +2 bonus to AC while carried.

name: Disc of Origin
notes: Oldest of the four. Heavier than the others, different stone. Angular markings read 'breath of the first wind.'
effect: When placed in a teleportation arch, keys the arch to the ruins northeast of Valdmere.

name: Disc of the Unnamed Plane
notes: Middle weight, old. Markings identify a destination neither Lenn nor Ilwuoshim recognized.
effect: When placed in a teleportation arch, keys the arch to an unknown, uncharted destination.

name: Disc of the Junction
notes: Lightest of the four. Markings identify it as a waypoint between two others.
effect: When placed in a teleportation arch, keys the arch to a waypoint hub built between two other arches — a transit point rather than a final destination.

name: Disc of Ilwuoshim's Second Arch
notes: Ilwuoshim's own making, identified by the djinn personally. Ilwuoshim wishes to visit when free. Keep safe.
effect: When placed in a teleportation arch, keys to an arch built by Ilwuoshim before the Liliveth was completed — never previously used.

name: Ring of Amity
effect: On attunement, bond with one willing creature by touch (rebond with a different willing creature instead at the end of any long rest; only one Ring of Amity's bond can affect a creature at a time). While bonded, whenever you're subjected to a spell or magical effect that restores hit points, the bonded creature also receives the same benefit. When the bonded creature HITS a target with an attack roll, you can use your reaction (within 60ft) to turn that hit into a critical hit — once invoked, this can't be used again until the next dawn. The bond ends if either of you changes planes, you bond a different creature, or you sever it as a bonus action.

name: Wolf Hunter's Rags
effect: While worn: the wearer gives off no scent and cannot be tracked by scent. The wearer cannot be detected, targeted, or perceived by divination magic (as per the nondetection spell).

name: Breastplate of the Broken Scale
notes: Recovered from an ancient battlefield beside dragon remains in a ravine.
effect: AC 14 + DEX modifier (max 2). Stormbreak Reserve: whenever the wearer takes 15 or more damage from a single attack or effect, the armor stores one charge (max 1 stored, tracked via charges above). As a bonus action, release a stored charge: 10ft radius force burst centered on self, 2d6 force damage (DC 15 DEX save for half) to all other creatures in range, each creature that fails is pushed 10ft away. Recharges automatically on the next qualifying hit.

name: Gauntlet of the Sundering Blow
notes: Recovered from the same ancient battlefield as the Breastplate of the Broken Scale; matching set.
effect: Sundering Strike: once per short rest, as part of a melee attack that hits, channel the gauntlet — the attack deals an additional 2d6 damage, and the target's AC is reduced by 2 until the end of the wearer's next turn.

name: Hand Crossbow of the Old Trail
notes: Recovered from a territorial Dire Pangolin's den.
effect: +2 to attack and damage rolls. Marked Shot: once per short rest, when firing a bolt, choose one rider effect: (a) target must succeed on a Constitution save or have speed halved until the end of its next turn, or (b) wielder gains advantage on their next attack roll against that target within 1 minute.

weapon_effects.name: Marked Shot
weapon_effects.description: On a hit, choose one: the target makes a Constitution save or has its speed halved until the end of its next turn, or you gain advantage on your next attack roll against that target within 1 minute.

name: Signet Ring
notes: Unidentified origin/bloodline — foreign craftsmanship, doesn't match Fol, Fynesmarch, or Torwald design conventions seen so far. Found on remains inside a territorial Dire Pangolin's den.
effect: Warding Press: once per long rest, press the ring to your skin to gain resistance to one damage type of your choice for 1 hour.

spells_granted.name: The Stones Agree
spells_granted.cost_note: Spent together with the Broken Vein bearer's own charge (see linked_item_id) — each bearer spends their own stone's charge, not a merged pool.

notes: Paired item — see Stone of the Broken Vein (Eldi) for the shared combo ability, The Stones Agree; linked via linked_item_id, though each stone tracks its own independent 1-charge/long-rest pool rather than a literally merged resource. Devised by someone untrained in the power it channels — see Attuned Stone Backlash (homebrew rule).
effect: Mold Earth (cantrip, 3/day, independent of the charge below): as the spell — reshape a 5-ft cube of nonmagical dirt or stone (raise, lower, excavate, or sculpt it); can't affect worked or magical stone, can't harm creatures. Wall of Stone (5th-level spell, 1/long rest): as the spell — conjure up to ten interlocking 10-ft-by-10-ft stone panels (6in thick, AC 15, 180 HP each), or 10-ft-by-20-ft panels at half thickness (3in, 90 HP each); must merge with and be supported by existing stone, spans over 20ft require halving panel size for support. Concentration, up to 10 minutes (can be made permanent by concentrating the full duration). This is the same charge that powers The Stones Agree (see homebrew spells) — spending it on one makes the other unavailable until the next long rest. Passive: tremorsense 30ft while attuned and touching the ground. Active uses (Mold Earth, Wall of Stone, The Stones Agree) trigger the Attuned Stone Backlash — DC 12 CON save or 1d6 damage. Passive tremorsense does not trigger it.

effect: Spike Growth (2nd-level spell, reflavored as jagged stone rather than thorns, 3/day, independent of the charge below): as the spell — ground in a 20-ft-radius sphere becomes difficult terrain; a creature moving into or within the area takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5ft traveled (no save). Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Erupting Earth (3rd-level spell, 1/long rest): as the spell — choose a point on the ground within range; a 20-ft cube of churned earth and stone erupts there. Each creature in the area makes a DEX save (DC 15, fixed rather than derived from the bearer's own stats) — 3d12 bludgeoning damage on a failure, half on success. The area becomes difficult terrain until cleared (1 minute per 5-ft square, by hand). Instantaneous — no concentration required. This is the same charge that powers The Stones Agree (see homebrew spells) — spending it on one makes the other unavailable until the next long rest. Passive: tremorsense 30ft while attuned and touching the ground. Active uses (Spike Growth, Erupting Earth, The Stones Agree) trigger the Attuned Stone Backlash — DC 12 CON save or 1d6 damage. Passive tremorsense does not trigger it.

name: Purple Ribbed Leather +2
notes: Purchased from Vethran & Son, Commerce District, Argentveil. Base AC 12 (studded-leather tier, reflavored as ribbed rather than studded), no DEX cap. Distinctive purple dye — the shopkeeper was glad to be rid of it.
